category_description: Pay, leave and government payments for people who work in Canada.
subcategory_description: Government payments for people who are out of work, raising children or on a low income.
label: Maximum CGEB for a single individual, per year
context: The most a single individual without children can get in the payment period. Paid in 4 quarterly payments.

label: Maximum CGEB for a married or common-law couple, per year
context: The most a married or common-law couple without children can get in the payment period.

label: CGEB for each eligible child under 19, per year
context: Added for each eligible child under 19.

label: CGEB base amount for an eligible individual or spouse, per year
context: Applies to an eligible individual and to an eligible spouse. A single individual without children gets an additional amount that phases in with income.

label: Income where the additional amount for a single individual without children starts to phase in
context: Adjusted family net income above this amount.

label: Income where the CGEB reduction starts
context: Adjusted family net income above this amount reduces the benefit.

label: Income at which a single individual without children stops getting CGEB
context: Adjusted family net income must be less than this amount.

label: Income at which a couple without children stops getting CGEB
context: Adjusted family net income must be less than this amount.

label: Income at which a family with one child stops getting CGEB
context: Adjusted family net income must be less than this amount.

label: Income at which a family with 2 children stops getting CGEB
context: Adjusted family net income must be less than this amount.

label: Income at which a family with 3 children stops getting CGEB
context: Adjusted family net income must be less than this amount.

label: Income at which a family with 4 or more children stops getting CGEB
context: Adjusted family net income must be less than this amount.

subject_intro: What the Canada Groceries and Essentials Benefit is, who is eligible, the maximum amounts for each situation, the income limits and how payments are made.
subject_meta_title: CGEB Canada: Up to {fact:ca_cgeb_single_max} a Year
subject_meta_description: The CGEB pays up to {fact:ca_cgeb_single_max} a year to a single adult and {fact:ca_cgeb_couple_max} to a couple, plus {fact:ca_cgeb_child} per child. See income limits and who qualifies.
